name: Korean Cultural Center Los Angeles (KCCLA)
about_text: The Korean Cultural Center Los Angeles (KCCLA) is a public cultural institution operated by the Republic of Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, located in the Miracle Mile district at 5505 Wilshire Blvd. It functions as a hub for Korean heritage and contemporary culture in the United States, housing a library, a permanent heritage exhibition hall, a second-floor art gallery, an auditorium (Ari Hall), and a media arts wall. Programming spans traditional and contemporary Korean art exhibitions, film screenings, Korean-language classes, and community-oriented shows organized with Korean-American arts associations, alongside field trips and cultural workshops for schools and the public.
